name: Oceanside Welding & Fabrication
old_description: Precision aluminum railings, gates, and fencing for homes and businesses.
about:
Oceanside Welding & Fabrication operates from Oakland Park, Florida, serving Broward and Palm Beach counties. The company was started by Jerry Menagh, who brought years of hands-on welding and aluminum fabrication experience to a small local operation that has grown into a family-owned shop.

The shop fabricates custom aluminum railings, gates, and fencing for residential and commercial properties, along with lanai column repair, trailer repair and fabrication, and general custom metal work in aluminum, stainless steel, and mild steel. Projects are handled in-house from design through cutting, welding, and installation, with powder coating coordinated as needed. A CNC plasma cutting capability is slated to come online soon. Both mobile on-site welding and in-shop fabrication are offered.

Customers include homeowners, builders, and property managers throughout South Florida, as well as marine clients needing pontoon repairs and landscaping or pressure-washing businesses requiring custom trailers. The company's work is tailored to withstand the region's coastal climate.

Menagh founded the business on a principle of doing the job right with pride, emphasizing craftsmanship, integrity, reliability, safety, and community. The company highlights transparent quoting, dependable timelines, and a fully welded, powder-coated product built for Florida's environment as key differentiators.
